goal: Iske baad aap bata sakenge ke programs ko files ki zaroorat kyun hoti hai, teeno file streams ke naam bata sakenge, aur kisi bhi file ke kaam ke liye open, check, use, close ke steps follow kar sakenge.
warmup: Apne mobile phone ke contacts ke baare mein sochein. Jab aap phone band karte hain, numbers kal bhi wahin hote hain. Wajah yeh hai ke woh phone ki storage mein save hote hain. Ab ek aisa number sochein jo aap sirf apne dimagh mein yaad rakhte hain jab tak pen dhoondh rahe hon: agar koi aap ko distract kar de, to woh gayab. Aam C++ variable dimagh mein rakhe number jaisa hai. Program khatam hote hi woh khatam ho jata hai. File save ki hui contact list jaisi hai.
definition: File disk par ek naam wali jagah hai (jaise marks.txt) jahan data hamesha ke liye store hota hai. Variables RAM mein rehte hain, jo temporary hai, is liye program khatam hote hi un mein jo kuch bhi tha woh chala jata hai, aur keyboard se jo type kiya tha woh agle run par dobara type karna padta hai. Text file data ko parhne wale characters ki shakal mein store karti hai: aap use Notepad mein khol sakte hain. (Binary file iske bajaye data ke raw bytes store karti hai aur Notepad mein parhi nahi ja sakti; is course mein hum sirf text files use karte hain.) C++ mein aap file ke saath stream ke zariye kaam karte hain, ek object jo data ko file tak ya file se laata hai. Header <fstream> aap ko teen stream types deta hai: ofstream (output, file mein likhta hai, cout ki tarah), ifstream (input, file se parhta hai, cin ki tarah) aur fstream (dono kaam kar sakta hai).
howItWorks: Har file ka kaam same steps follow karta hai. (1) #include <fstream>. (2) Stream object banayein aur use file ka naam dein, masalan ofstream out("data.txt"); yeh file ko open bhi kar deta hai. (3) if (!out) se check karein ke file khuli ya nahi. (4) << (likhne ke liye) ya >> aur getline (parhne ke liye) use karein. (5) out.close() se file band karein. Trace dekhein: pehli stream names.txt banati hai aur Ali likhti hai, doosri ek hi file ko ios::app ke saath kholti hai aur Sana jodti hai, teesri use wapas parhti hai. File ka naam relative path hota hai: program use apne working folder mein dhoondta hai, yaani us folder mein jahan program chal raha hai. "data.txt" jaisa naam ka matlab hai "mere apne folder mein". C:\\Users\\Ali\\data.txt jaisa poora path na likhein, kyunke woh kisi doosre computer par maujood nahi hoga. Jab aap ofstream se likhte hain aur file pehle se maujood ho, to uska purana content mit jata hai. Purana content rakhna ho aur naya text aakhir mein jodna ho, to file ko ios::app se kholein. Is hafte ki examples mein har program pehle file likhta hai aur phir use wapas parhta hai, taake aap kisi aur tool ke baghair nateeja dekh saken.
